newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangzhou Power issues 100 mln A shares Friday.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Power issues 100 mln A shares Friday.

text.p: Guangzhou Power Enterprise (Holdings) Co Ltd issued 100 million A shares including 10 million shares owned by staff at 7.87 yuan per share on Friday for listing in Shanghai, the Xinhua news agency said.

Proceeds amounting to 772.5 million yuan ($93.1 million) will be raised through the issue, which will be mainly used to build the second-stage of the Guangzhou Pearl River Power Plant, it said on Friday.
The second phase of the Guangzhou Pearl River Power Plant is scheduled to go into operation late this year and the third phase is due for completion early in the 21st century, Xinhua said.
When completed, the power plant will have a capacity of 2.4 million kilowatts and be able to generate 12 billion kilowatt hours of electricity annually, it said.
Guangzhou Power is the city's largest power supplier. It holds a 50 percent stake in the Guangzhou Pearl River Power Co Ltd, it said.

After the issue, the company will have a total of 666 million shares outstanding, of which A shares account for 15.015 percent. The remaining 566 million shares are held by institutions, a company prospectus said.
The company forecast 1997 net profit at 283.19 million yuan based on a 33 percent income tax rate, compared with 302.14 million yuan booked in 1996, it said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
